name: Prisma MCP
description: Lets agents create and manage Prisma Postgres databases, run SQL and schema updates, restore backups, and operate Prisma Compute apps and Object Storage over a remote MCP server.

skills.name: Database Management
skills.description: Creates, lists, and deletes Prisma Postgres databases and their connection strings in the selected workspace.

skills.name: SQL and Schema
skills.description: Introspects a database schema, runs SQL queries, and applies schema updates to a Prisma Postgres database.

skills.name: Backup Recovery
skills.description: Lists automated backups and restores a Prisma Postgres database to a new database from a chosen backup.

skills.name: Compute Deployments
skills.description: Lists Prisma Compute apps, builds, and deployments, reads runtime logs, and promotes, rolls back, starts, or stops deployments.

skills.name: Object Storage
skills.description: Creates and deletes object-store buckets and S3-compatible access keys in a Prisma project.
